channel.description: Steelers headlines from beat writers, national outlets and blogs, with our one-line summaries and links to the publisher. Unofficial fan site. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Pittsburgh Steelers or the NFL. Headlines and links belong to their original publishers; we grant no rights in them. Summaries, grades, ratings, rumor tiers, needs and board rankings and analysis are written by Black & Gold Dispatch: credit 'Black & Gold Dispatch' and link to the original publisher (the `url` field). Scores, schedule, stats, depth chart, injuries and the stats behind stats-based grades come from nflverse (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), licensed CC-BY 4.0: you may reuse them if you credit 'Data: nflverse (CC-BY 4.0)'. College prospect stats come from CollegeFootballData.com (https://collegefootballdata.com): credit 'Data: CollegeFootballData.com'; we grant no rights in their data. Wikipedia-derived facts are CC BY-SA 4.0 (credit Wikipedia). Social posts are not reproduced; follow the link to the author. Do not republish full articles.
